✦ Get to Know VAULX

One builder, held to a vault's standard.

VAULX is the studio built by Roquib — a Lagos-based developer and designer who treats every client relationship the way a vault treats what's inside it: with discretion, structure, and follow-through, even after the invoice is paid.

Every engagement runs on the same principle the name is built on — the work should still hold up when things get difficult, not just on launch day.

✦ What We Do

Five ways VAULX builds your presence

Website Design & Development

// Got Questions?

Frequently asked questions

Why should I choose VAULX?+

One builder, one point of contact — design and development come from the same hand, with direct communication and no relay through a sales layer.

What services do you offer?+

Website design and development, web and mobile applications, UI/UX design, branding and graphic design (including business logo creation), and ongoing maintenance and IT support.

How much does a project cost?+

It depends on scope, features, and complexity. After an initial consult, you'll get a clear proposal with pricing — VAULX works with a range of budgets.

How long does a project take?+

A basic website typically takes 3–5 weeks. Larger applications or full brand builds take longer, scoped during consult.

What happens after the project is completed?+

Maintenance and IT support is one of VAULX's core services, not an afterthought — the relationship continues after launch.
